name: ASBO Labs
changelog:
1.3.0-beta.2

  • Turns the desktop Items screen into a true split workspace with independently scrolling product and configuration panes, reducing page-level scrolling.
  • Existing project items now reopen with their decoration, variation/size and quantity choices restored.
  • Adds direct quantity entry plus +6/+12 desktop quick-add controls for faster bulk ordering.
  • Adds clearer project-item state, remove/edit actions, saved-project confirmation toasts, and an always-available How it works helper.
  • Streamlines Artwork copy and makes project-summary items directly editable.
  • Remains a read-only UX sandbox: no WooCommerce cart/order/artwork/stock/product writes and no production latest.json changes.
